title: coba-web: Digital Advertising & Bidding Domain Reframe
text: coba-web: Digital Advertising & Bidding Domain Reframe
intent: Reframe all 6 coba-web pages from generic arm/feature terminology to a realistic Digital Advertising & Bidding domain, preserving all bandit mechanics while making the context immediately recognisable to AdTech practitioners.

steps.text: Audit current pages and map each to a concrete AdTech scenario
Redesign data generators in backend/engine/data.py with ad-specific context vectors and reward semantics (CTR/CVR)
Rewrite request models in backend/models/requests.py with ad-domain vocabulary
Reframe Playground page as Ad Creative Optimizer (LinUCB selecting ad creatives per user segment)
Reframe Policy Lab as Bidding Strategy Race (compare policies on click-through reward signals)
Reframe Drift Lab as Seasonality & Trend Drift (weekend spike, campaign fatigue)
Reframe Offline Eval as Historical Bid Log Evaluation (biased toward high-spend placements)
Reframe Arm Lifecycle as Creative Refresh (hot-swap creatives mid-campaign)
Reframe Production Ops as Budget-Aware Bidding (normalize eCPM, enforce impression-share floors)
Update frontend labels, descriptions, and chart axis titles across all 6 pages
Verify backend tests pass and update any test fixtures that reference old arm names
